title: A Trip to the Shop
text:
Anna goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs bread, milk and eggs. The shop is near her home. It is open from eight in the morning.

In the shop, Anna also buys a red bag. The bag costs two euros. She pays with a card. Then she walks home with her shopping.

questions.text: What does Anna need to buy?
How much does the red bag cost?
Why does Anna probably not need a car to go shopping?
options: The shop is near her home.
The shop is open at night.

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's shopping trip?
options: It is a quick trip for a few things.
She buys food for a big party.

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven
round foods laid by hens, often eaten for breakfast
a small plastic card used to pay for things

paragraph_translations: Anna idzie do sklepu w sobotę. Potrzebuje chleba, mleka i jajek. Sklep jest blisko jej domu. Jest otwarty od ósmej rano.
W sklepie Anna kupuje też czerwoną torbę. Torba kosztuje dwa euro. Płaci kartą. Potem wraca do domu ze swoimi zakupami.
